_comment: Synthetic two-tenant corpus for the retrieval eval. Every item has a stable fixture key (<meeting>.t<i> transcript chunk, .c<i> commitment, .d<i> decision, .s summary). Queries reference KEYS, never database ids. Team B deliberately overlaps team A (billing, Stripe, webhooks, a different 'Ahmed') as isolation bait.

meetings.title: Billing Architecture Review
chunks: Ahmed Hassan
We evaluated storing subscription state locally versus reading it from the provider on every request. Local state with webhook sync is faster but needs idempotent webhook handling.
Omar Siddiqui
My concern is webhook retries causing duplicate charges. We need an idempotency key per event and a dead letter queue.
Priya Nair
Agreed. If the webhook endpoint is down for an hour we could miss plan changes, so we need a reconciliation job.

commitments.text: Add idempotency keys and a dead letter queue for billing webhooks

decisions: Subscription state is stored locally and kept in sync through idempotent webhook handlers plus a nightly reconciliation job.
meetings.summary: Billing architecture review: subscription state is kept locally and synced by idempotent webhooks with a nightly reconciliation job; duplicate charges are prevented with idempotency keys.

meetings.title: Sprint 22 Retro
chunks: Maya Chen
What went well: the plan selection flow shipped on time. What slowed us down: the staging database access took eleven days.

Omar Siddiqui

commitments.text: Write the load test plan for the webhook handler

decisions: Staging access requests will be automated and the team will track the lead time as a sprint metric.

meetings.title: Vendor Evaluation: Paddle vs Stripe
chunks: Maya Chen
Paddle acts as merchant of record and handles VAT globally, which saves us finance work. Stripe gives more control but we would own tax compliance.
Priya Nair
I still prefer Stripe's API, it is more pleasant to work with. But Paddle's tax handling is a big win for a small team.
Ahmed Hassan
Paddle webhooks are signed with a shared secret and support retries, which fits our idempotent design.
decisions: We are going with Paddle as the billing provider because it handles VAT as merchant of record.
meetings.summary: Vendor evaluation: the team chose Paddle over Stripe for billing because Paddle is the merchant of record and handles VAT worldwide. Priya preferred Stripe's API.

meetings.title: Security Review: Webhooks
chunks: Omar Siddiqui
The webhook endpoint must verify the signature before parsing the body, and reject events older than five minutes to prevent replay.
Priya Nair
We also need to rotate the webhook secret every ninety days. I will document the rotation procedure.

decisions: Webhook events older than five minutes are rejected and the secret rotates every ninety days.
